purpose: One source-backed record per Austin place: what the place is, which water it is on, which measured stations relate to it and how, and what is still missing before a color may be shown. This file asserts relationships; it never asserts conditions.

relationship_class.rule_linked_product_baseline: A third-party product maps the place to this station and publishes flow bands. Recorded as a baseline, not validated hydrology. This is the only class that currently permits a color, and only under data/rules.json.
relationship_class.context_station_upstream: The station sits upstream of the place on the same mapped channel. Its reading describes water on its way to the place before any intervening inflow, loss, or control.
relationship_class.context_station_downstream: The station sits downstream of the place on the same mapped channel. Its reading integrates the place's reach plus everything between.
relationship_class.context_same_waterbody_unpositioned: Same named creek, but the place coordinate does not resolve to the mapped channel, so the along-channel position was not computed.
relationship_class.spring_discharge_context: A spring-discharge station describes the spring that feeds a managed pool; it says nothing about hours, closures, or admission.
relationship_class.none: No station relationship is recorded. The place stays gray for hydrology.
relationship_class.rule_linked_provisional_personal: A provisional band authored from a local observer's recorded visits and the station's own event thresholds (data/rules.json). Permits a color with the evidence label "limited evidence". Not validated by holdout; revise as labels arrive.
relationship_class.rule_linked_hypothesis: A low-confidence mapped station relation permits a visibly pale place-level guess under an explicit rule; the gauge does not measure swimming depth or current at the place.

confidence.medium: Both points resolve to the same OpenStreetMap way and an along-channel position was computed; intervening tributaries, diversions, and losing reaches were not inventoried.
confidence.low: Same waterbody, but the place coordinate is approximate or a third-party mapping is the only link.

how_to_read.geometry_evidence: data/model/austin-reach-geometry.json (tools/reach_geometry.py) gives the nearest mapped node, distance to channel, and metres along the way for every point. Along-channel figures below are rounded from that file and depend on the saved place coordinate, which is often a park or trailhead reference rather than the water entry.
how_to_read.color_gate: A place may be colored only when verified_entry, documented_relationship, local_rule, and fresh_data_path are all satisfied and no active closure applies (AUSTIN_SWIM_MODEL_HANDOFF.md, layer 4).

waterbody_notes.Barton Creek: Barton Creek crosses the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone between the Loop 360 station and Barton Springs; karst recharge through faults and fissures means flow can be lost between an upstream station and a downstream pool (source: capability-matrix entry edwards-hydrogeology, Edwards Aquifer Authority). Reach-specific loss rates were not acquired.
waterbody_notes.Bull Creek: Bull Creek drains 22.3 square miles at USGS 08154700 (station metadata, HUC 120902050302) and enters Lake Austin just below Bull Creek District Park. Whether Lake Austin backwater affects the lowest reach was not verified.
waterbody_notes.Blunn Creek: Blunn Creek flows north from the Blunn Creek Nature Preserve area past Big Stacy and Little Stacy parks toward Lady Bird Lake; the saved OSM way runs south to north, consistent with that direction.
waterbody_notes.Onion Creek: Onion Creek passes the McKinney Falls State Park falls before reaching USGS 08159000 at US 183. TPWD names both Onion and Williamson creeks inside the park; whether the Williamson confluence lies between the falls and the US 183 station was not verified.
waterbody_notes.Shoal Creek: Shoal Creek is an urban runoff creek gauged at W 12th Street (USGS 08156800). No swimming entry is verified anywhere on it.
waterbody_notes.Walnut Creek: Walnut Creek near the Domain has no active USGS discharge station: catalog stations 08158100 (FM 1325, series ended 1986) and 08158105 (Metric Blvd, no series) were probed on 2026-09-29 (data/model/austin-candidate-station-probe.json). 08158600 (Webberville Rd, far downstream) was not probed.
waterbody_notes.Lake Austin: Lake Austin elevation is published by LCRA Hydromet (https://hydromet.lcra.org/Reports/LakeLevel); the page renders through scripts and no machine-readable endpoint was captured on 2026-09-29. No site-specific shoreline threshold exists for either park.
